rationale: Pulp carries two independent popup-dismissal mechanisms that every platform host wires separately: ComboBox::notify_global_click for the native combo dropdown, and the View active-overlay slot that @pulp/react's overlay prop and every imported or materialized design popover claims. The standalone macOS host and the web host consult both; the macOS and Windows DAW plugin hosts consulted only the ComboBox one, so an outside press inside a plugin editor never reached the generalized dismissal path. Making the decision portable requires a route_press_to_active_overlay verb in pointer dispatch next to deliver_mouse_down, which is where Pulp already hoists host press logic so it can be exercised headlessly. This is Pulp-specific plug-in-host and @pulp/react bridge integration: the duplicated mechanisms exist because Pulp grew a native widget dropdown and a React-driven overlay slot separately, and the fix binds them to Pulp's own per-host press paths. A future Vellum framework should carry a single overlay-dismissal contract in its own host abstraction rather than adopt this reconciliation.
